title: Saudi Arabian Speck Feast
description: A hearty, flavorful dish from Saudi Arabia, perfect for a festive occasion.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced speck and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper (if using), salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the spice mixture.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the rice is heated through.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for a few minutes.
Serve the rice mixture in a bowl, topped with warm pita bread and a side of your choice.
Garnish with fresh herbs, such as parsley or cilantro, if desired.
